sloka: इदं ब्रूयाश्च मे नाथं शूरं रामं पुनः पुनः ।जीवितं धारयिष्यामि मासं दशरथात्मज ।। ५.३८.६७।।।।
transliteration: idaṁ brūyāśca me nāthaṁ śūraṁ rāmaṁ punaḥ punaḥ ।jīvitaṁ dhārayiṣyāmi māsaṁ daśarathātmaja ।। 5.38.67।।।।

translations.english: "I will hold on to life only for a month. Beyond, I will not survive. I swear by truth. You may tell this to Rama.
